title: Constant-extension restriction and residue-local operator specifications
statement: Fix a finite-field datum $D$, $m\ge1$, a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme $X_0$, and the actual extension datum $D_m$, model $X_{0,m}$ and fibre isomorphism $a:X_m\simeq X$ [def-dl-a1-constant-extension-data]. Fix $\ell\ne p$ and an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$. Use the common-stage Weil heart and its forgetful functor [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex]. The canonical fibre pullback is $a^*$ [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Define $\theta^{[m]}$ by composing the $m$ successive Weil maps with the integral-normalized pullback compositors [def-zl-weil-ind-sheaf-category], and the return comparison from these compositors and the geometric identity $g_m a=a g^m$. For a functor $R$ between the original and extended Weil hearts, ConstantExtensionRestrictionSpec means a natural carrier isomorphism $\alpha:\operatorname{For}R\simeq a^*\operatorname{For}$ satisfying $g_m^*\alpha\,\mathrm{return}\,a^*\theta^{[m]}=\theta_R\alpha$ at every object. Define the closed image of $z\in X_{0,m}$ by the actual finite projection and its closedness proof, and its residue degree as $[\kappa(z):\kappa(x)]$, the finrank for the induced residue-field algebra. For any finite-type $k_0$-model $Y_0$, Weil sheaves $F$ on $Y_0$ and $G$ on $X_{0,m}$, closed points $x,z$, and $f\in\mathbf N$, ConstantExtensionLocalConjugacy means that, for every common finite Weil presentation and all compatible residue embeddings into $k$, the scalar-extended degree-zero stalk operators of [def-weil-local-frobenius-trace] are conjugate by an $\Omega$-linear isomorphism, the operator at $z$ corresponding to the $f$th power at $x$.
